question.problem:
Calculate the volume $V$ of the parallelepiped spanned by $x=⟨3,0,-2⟩$, $y=⟨1,2,4⟩$, and $z=⟨-5,1,1⟩.$

$V=${{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
The volume of the parallelepiped spanned by three vectors is given by the absolute value of their triple product.

First, we compute the triple product:

$$
\begin{aligned}x\cdot (y\times z) & =|\begin{aligned}3 & 0 & -2 \\ 1 & 2 & 4 \\ -5 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =3\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & 4 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ -5 & 1\end{aligned}|+(-2)\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ -5 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =3(2\cdot 1-4\cdot 1)+0+(-2)(1\cdot 1-2\cdot (-5)) \\  & =-6-22 \\  & =-28\end{aligned}
$$

    

Finally, we take the absolute value. So, the volume of the corresponding parallelepiped is 

$$
V=|-28|=28.
$$
